```plato
    // The isoperimetric quotient 4*Pi*Area / Perimeter^2: a scale-invariant
    // compactness measure in (0, 1], equal to 1 only for a disc
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isoperimetric_inequality).
    // Precondition: non-zero perimeter.
    IsoperimetricQuotient(self: IArea): Number
        => 4.0 * self.Area.Pi * self.Area / (self.Perimeter * self.Perimeter);
```
